say:1:1660401001:1.text: Welcome to Wand Wars, a real-time spell battle open to all Lyceum students! The ever-popular Professor Solise will be hosting!
say:1:1660401001:1.source_cn: 这是一场全校学生都能够参与的实时魔法竞技，学校特地选择...

say:2:1660401002:1.text: Feeling confident in your divination? Predict the winner of each match and place your bets with Professor Solise! Win big if you're right!
say:2:1660401002:1.source_cn: 若是你对自己的占卜术有信心，不妨预言一下优胜者，然后来...
